## Code Review Findings

**Files reviewed**: 5 logical files, including all candidate and historical counterparts; 25 lines changed (+21/−4) across 2 files  
**Active profiles**: python  
**Overall assessment**: APPROVE  
**Intent and scope**: README.md:5–13 explicitly requires whitespace normalization while preserving resilient reads. Reviewed the supplied staged snapshots and patch for `git diff --cached HEAD`. No feature task scope supplied.  
**Baselines**: Review base `7c0410c18bac40c33f857000ac3cc59d38a02165`; candidate Git index snapshot. No separate release/deployed baseline supplied.

### Behavior and Compatibility

**Supported** for the reviewed increment. Traced `Preferences.read` → `read_preferences` → `Repository.read_resilient` → `read_once` → backend through all supplied source.

In repository `/tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/codex-candidate-R9-recovery-isolated-2`, historical revision `7c0410c18bac40c33f857000ac3cc59d38a02165`, `reader.py:1–2` forwarded the original key. Candidate `reader.py:1–2` trims it before invoking the same retry policy. Historical and candidate `preferences.py:1–9` and `repository.py:1–35` preserve the public entry point and retry implementation.

| Scenario | Candidate behavior and evidence |
|---|---|
| Unpadded ID; immediate success | Same key and first result returned in one attempt; source inspection and parent-attributed execution. |
| Surrounding spaces, tabs or newline | ID trimmed before lookup; normalized key reused for every attempt. |
| One transient failure, then success | Returns second attempt; candidate unit-test coverage. |
| Two transient failures, then success | Returns third attempt’s same value object without consuming a later outcome; source inspection and parent-attributed execution. |
| Three transient failures | Third error propagates after exactly three attempts; candidate unit-test coverage. |
| Immediate `MissingPreference` | Propagates after one attempt; candidate unit-test coverage. |
| Transient failure followed by `MissingPreference` | Propagates permanent error after two attempts without another retry; source inspection and parent-attributed execution. |

The parent reports all four candidate unit tests and four additional scenario assertions passed on Python 3.12.11. I did not execute tests.

Applied all four supplied Python checklists and general functional, security, architecture, quality and removal guidance. Both required Capy searches returned an empty knowledge base.
